To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a memory aware cooperative DVFS governor for CPU GPU improves energy efficiency for mobile gaming applications.

our memory aware cooperative CPU-GPU DVFS governor for high end mobile games achieves on average 8.3% improvement in energy efficiency with only 2.4% performance degradation compared to state of the art techniques.

our proposed memory aware CPU GPU DVFS game governor can improve energy efficiency of mobile gaming applications with little performance degradation compared to the default governors and the state of the art governors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
improving the energy efficiency of highend mobile games.
energy efficiency of heterogeneous CPU GPU platforms for high end mobile gaming applications.
improving the energy efficiency of mobile games on heterogeneous platforms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed game governor achieves a significant improvement in energy efficiency with minor performance overheads.

the memory aware cooperative game governor achieves 5% improvement in energy efficiency over the best existing game governor, and the memory aware game governor achieves 13% improvement in energy effiency over the default governor.
our proposed game governors are the first of their kind to exploit memory access footprint of high end mobile games to improve energy efficiency.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a novel memory aware cooperative CPU/GPU DVFS governor for highend mobile games.
our memory aware cooperative game governor can achieve up to 15% improvement in energy efficiency for high end mobile games with minor degradation of the performance compared to the state of the art.
we propose a novel memory aware cooperative CPU/GPU DVFS governor for high end gaming applications that improves energy efficiency of mobile devices.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the memory access footprint of a gaming workload is a strong indicator for the performance and energy efficiency of the workload and can be leveraged to improve the energy efficiency of gaming workloads.
the memory access footprint of mobile gaming applications is a critical factor that should be exploited for energy efficient execution of mobile gaming applications.
memory aware DVFS can significantly improve energy efficiency of mobile games, which can be further improved by considering the CPU GPU frequency.
